sourceEvidence.title: Vice President of Operations
sourceEvidence.quote: What You Bring 10+ years of progressive operations leadership, ideally spanning supply chain/vendor management and shop-floor or plant operations in distribution, industrial, or manufacturing environments Experience building and scaling operational infrastructure in a PE-backed or high-growth company Experience leading multi-site operations and cross-trained, flexible workforces Experience with inventory management systems and freight/logistics management, ideally in distribution or capital equipment Experience owning quality and warranty programs, including root-cause analysis and cost-of-non-conformance reduction Strong process discipline and comfort building KPIs, SLAs, and scorecards from scratch Comfort operating at both the strategic (executive leadership) and tactical (shop floor, vendor negotiation) level
